children: Special purpose acquisition company ARC Group Acquisition I agreed to a business combination which would see it take Malaysian company Firstborn Top Capital public.

Firstborn Top Capital is a licensed private financing company serving individuals and businesses across Malaysia. The deal would provide capital to allow Firstborn Top Capital to accelerate growth in Malaysia and across Southeast Asia, the companies said.

Following the close of the deal, ARC Group Acquisition would be renamed BlueCrest Investment, and Firstborn Top Capital would become its wholly-owned subsidiary. The combined company is expected to list on the Nasdaq Global Market under the symbol BCIN.

The companies said the deal reflects an implied pro forma enterprise value at closing of about $1.09 billion, assuming ARC Group Acquisition I raises $5 million in PIPE financing and assuming 0% redemption from $120.8 million in the company's trust account.
Ow Ruey Shen, executive director, is expected to continue to lead Firstborn Top Capital.
The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of next year, the companies added.
